```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load required libraries
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Read in your Excel file
df <- read_excel("morph_clean.xlsx")

# Clean column names (replace spaces and dots with underscores)
names(df) <- gsub(" |\\.", "_", names(df))

# Summarize data by Location, Life Stage, and Variety
summary_table <- df %>%
  group_by(Location, Life_S, variety) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    mean_height = mean(Height, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_blade_width = mean(Blade_width_largest_at_widest_point_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_divisions = mean(Divisions, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dry_weight = mean(dry_weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Print summary table
print(summary_table)
write.csv(summary_table, file = "output/plots_morph/morphometric_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Function to summarize height statistics
summarize_height <- function(data, group_var) {
  data %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_var]]) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_height = mean(Height, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q1 = quantile(Height, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      Median = quantile(Height, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q3 = quantile(Height, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# Ensure output directory exists
output_dir <- "output/plots_morph"
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Summary by variety
height_by_variety <- summarize_height(df, "variety")
cat("\n--- Height Summary by Variety ---\n")
print(height_by_variety)
write.csv(height_by_variety, file = file.path(output_dir, "height_summary_by_variety.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Summary by Life Stage
height_by_life <- summarize_height(df, "Life_S")
cat("\n--- Height Summary by Life Stage ---\n")
print(height_by_life)
write.csv(height_by_life, file = file.path(output_dir, "height_summary_by_life_stage.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Summary by Location
height_by_location <- summarize_height(df, "Location")
cat("\n--- Height Summary by Location ---\n")
print(height_by_location)
write.csv(height_by_location, file = file.path(output_dir, "height_summary_by_location.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Generate and save plots by Location
plot_morph_var(df, "Height", "Location", plot_dir)
plot_morph_var(df, "Blade_width_largest_at_widest_point_mm", "Location", plot_dir)
plot_morph_var(df, "Divisions", "Location", plot_dir)
plot_morph_var(df, "dry_weight", "Location", plot_dir)

# Additional plots by variety
plot_morph_var(df, "Height", "variety", plot_dir)
plot_morph_var(df, "Blade_width_largest_at_widest_point_mm", "variety", plot_dir)
plot_morph_var(df, "dry_weight", "variety", plot_dir)


```
